column7: TOTP (pquerna/otp, HMAC-SHA-1) panicked under GODEBUG=fips140=only ("crypto/hmac: use of hash functions other than SHA-2 or SHA-3 is not allowed in FIPS 140-only mode") in ActivateMFA, VerifyMFALogin, VerifyMFAStepUp and DisableMFA/requireReauth. Under fips140.Enforced() BeginMFAEnrollment and ActivateMFA now refuse first with ErrTOTPUnavailableInFIPSMode, and login, step-up and reauth refuse a six-digit (TOTP-shaped) input before any TOTP or recovery evaluation, wrapping ErrMFAVerificationUnavailable so the attempt stays pre-verdict: audited mfa.error, never counted toward the lockout, budget slot returned. The default-mode seam test forces enforcement and pins every path; TestTOTP_FIPSRefusal_ReauthPasswordStillCounted pins that a password reauth is still counted and TestTOTP_FIPSRefusal_RecoveryCodeLoginStillWorks that recovery codes keep working. Red (fips140=only, TestTOTP_UnderFIPS140Only_RefusedNotPanic, skips in default CI) at 5d80e2cfc: panic. FIPS-TAILS-2 item 1.
